title: Art. 6 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter II - Documentation and Duties of the Parties Relating to the Carriage of Passengers, Baggage and Cargo, Article 6 — Document Relating to the Nature of the Cargo
theme: Documentation and Duties of the Parties
content: The consignor may be required, if necessary to meet the formalities of customs, police and similar public authorities, to deliver a document indicating the nature of the cargo. This provision creates for the carrier no duty, obligation or liability resulting therefrom.
